**Final submission: deviation (T4C), cured at the preferred level.**

The verifier's substantive review confirms the proposal is position-complete, minimal and intent-preserving, and identifies the remaining deterministic flag as a baseline artefact reflecting the pre-redline Paragraph 18 (which indeed contained no Customer convenience right — that absence is the deviation). No further operative repair was available or needed, so I re-validated the same operation (ok:true, minimality ok) and submitted.

- **Deviation:** 25-year Initial Period with exit only at/after its end (18.1) or by unanimity (18.2), plus forfeiture of capital-cost credit (18.4) — no Customer convenience right, failing both preferred and fallback.
- **Cure:** one insertion, new Subparagraph 18.8 — Customer may terminate this Agreement as to itself for convenience on 30 days' written notice, with pro-rata refund of charges prepaid for the post-termination period; expressly additive to 18.1.
- **Counterparty element:** already met by retained 18.1/18.2 and mapped as already_met on a verbatim quote, not re-drafted.
- **Negotiation note carried in the rationale:** 18.7 may be extended to 18.8 if pressed; 18.4 should not be.
